_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE shape-only fixture for the commit-conventions suite — it documents the SHAPE a conforming runner emits (top-level keys + per-case `cases[]` entries), not golden values. The real headline numbers come from your own `skillevaluation run ./examples/commit-conventions` (the without-skill arm fails the convention; the with-skill arm passes). turns/tool_calls are 1/0 because the default `llm` adapter is single-shot.

cases._note: Without-skill emits Conventional Commits ('feat: add retry to http client'); with-skill emits '[PROJ-101] NET: add retry to the http client'.
Without-skill can't know a migration maps to DATA; with-skill emits '[PROJ-105] DATA: ...'.
Without-skill has no UI area code; with-skill emits '[PROJ-103] UI: ...'.
Without-skill can't know the CORE fallback; with-skill emits '[PROJ-104] CORE: ...'.
Both arms answer the git-fetch question plainly; the skill correctly does not over-activate.
